S50M26.risk_note: Educational analysis only — not trade advice. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index, not the futures contract; pinning and max-pain tendencies are structurally weaker than for physically-settled single stocks, so treat every pin as a tendency, not a guarantee. On expiry day, the SET50 index fixing can diverge meaningfully from the futures price — factor in the cash-futures basis. Short-vol structures carry negative-skew payoff (small frequent gains, rare large losses); size accordingly.
